attributes.gaiada.note: Starter realm imported on first boot (--import-realm). Matches docs/runbooks/idp-keycloak.md. AFTER import: (1) regenerate the gaiada-platform client secret in the admin console and wire it into the platform, (2) confirm MFA is enforced, (3) flip PLATFORM_AUTH_MODE=oidc, (4) run ./keycloak/configure-smtp.sh once (see gaiada.smtp-note) — the smtpServer block below is NOT live-substituted by the importer.
attributes.gaiada.smtp-note: MAIL-03 (ex-Q-V6, settled dev-provable): Keycloak's realm-import (DirImportProvider, KC 26.0.8) does NOT expand ${env.*} placeholders in smtpServer or anywhere else in an imported realm file — proven by importing a throwaway realm with smtpServer.host='${env.ZZZ_TEST}' and finding the literal string, unexpanded, in the persisted realm. The smtpServer values below are therefore committed as an honest, working DEV DEFAULT (the Mailpit sink), not a template the importer fills in. A fresh box still needs one explicit step after import: run `./keycloak/configure-smtp.sh` (reads the same KC_SMTP_* env the keycloak service container sees) to push real values via kcadm. Re-run it any time KC_SMTP_* changes; import alone will not pick up a change.
